description: A joke module that fills your patch with other people's module choices: one click drops a rack's worth of randomly picked modules into the patch beside the mouse
notes: Click the question mark and the module picks two VCOs, two LFOs, two VCAs, a sequencer, a clock, three effects, two filters, two envelopes, three utilities, a mixer and an audio interface.
A scope arrives with the batch as well, alongside the audio interface, so the patch has an output to your speakers and a display from the start.
The new modules appear at the mouse pointer and push the existing patch aside. Each is added to the undo history on its own, so undoing one click takes one press of undo per module.
The picking runs off the tags each maker set on their own modules, so what you get depends on which plugins you have installed. Anything tagged External is left out.
Clicking again adds another batch on top of the first. Nothing is removed and nothing is replaced.
The question mark is drawn as a plain button rather than as a module parameter, so it cannot be clicked for help and it is not saved or restored with the patch.
menu: Randomize Parameters — when this is on, every module the button spawns has its knobs randomized as it arrives; it comes up off
